image_prompts.produit: Create ONE extraordinary photorealistic luxury product-advertising photograph, vertical 9:16, designed as the opening frame of a premium cinematic video for a creative agency. A single unbranded sculptural AMBER GLASS PERFUME BOTTLE, solid rectangular body with gently rounded shoulders, small polished dark bronze cylindrical cap, NO LABEL and absolutely NO WRITING anywhere. Bottle stands upright on a low wet charcoal basalt monolith in the lower center of frame, a thin reflective film of water and a few physically plausible droplets on glass. A dramatic warm golden shaft of backlight passes through the amber glass, forming a luminous copper caustic across black stone; velvety black negative space above the bottle, controlled rim light, subtle atmospheric mist behind, elegant editorial composition. Extremely realistic thick glass edges, correct refraction, precise cap, physically correct reflections. High-end global luxury cosmetics campaign, macro 85mm product photography, deep charcoal, warm copper and soft ivory palette, rich blacks with recoverable detail, no CGI plastic appearance, no floating rocks, no explosion, no impossible objects, no people, no text, no logo, no watermark. Camera is at a low three-quarter macro angle, shallow optical depth of field, very fine highlights in chocolate, appetizing warm amber key light from left and a delicate cool soft fill to preserve chocolate texture. Luxury food cinematography, 85mm lens, deep charcoal, copper, dark cocoa and soft ivory palette, coherent natural geometry, no huge splashes, no hands, no people, no duplicate utensils, no writing, no logo, no watermark. Food must be real restaurant food rather than a 3D illustration. Leave calm darker background in the upper third suitable for typography added later.

The shot must be simple enough for a slow 4-second dolly-in with strong temporal stability.
